vectors.description: an expected output states the keys it names: a change of a key it does not name is unexpected, though the case passes
a change of an output is expected when the case names every key that differs, in output or at its position in outputs; naming only some of them leaves it unexpected, though the case passes
the new version's cases state the new output: the changes are expected, though one states only the part that differs; the old version fails them
a change is expected only when the case checks every part that differs: the selection alone does not cover another output
a change is expected only when the new version passes its case
an error that is gone is expected only by an expectation that states the new decision (its selection or outputs): not by an empty one, nor by unknown alone
a new error that the new version's case expects: the change is expected, and the side passed with its error
